spatial_bounds: Only the fictional Fixture Basin places plus one distant fictional observatory are represented.
selection_rationale: Exercise every required semantic distinction with the smallest reviewable package.

known_exclusions.description: No unlisted people, events, states, processes or regions are represented.
No route geometry is provided for the inferred trajectory gap.
The package does not claim historical completeness or historical absence.

density_limitations: One or two records per semantic case; not suitable for user-value validation.
source_criteria: Every fixture Claim with applicable evidence has a reproducible locator in an immutable checked-in synthetic source document.
review_criteria: Two independent semantic reviews against the spatial-temporal and epistemic contracts are required before READY.
